title: How can trapped air escape when quenching an inverted aluminium alloy dished head?
summary: A continuous venting path is needed inside an inverted dished head, and the vent structure, water-entry direction and basket descent must work together. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s aluminium-alloy dished-head quenching furnace proposal, dated 24 March 2022, incorporates a segmented tubular venting device with openings into the basket to discharge internal gas during rapid immersion. The tank also has mechanical agitation directed towards its centre and upward water jets from beneath the basket. Equipment selection should assess both transfer speed and the conditions that let water reach the inner surface.
